description: Defines the ObliviousHttpResponse class for handling Oblivious HTTP responses, including creation, encryption, decryption, serialization, and related cryptographic parameters.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpResponse
classes.description: Handles Oblivious HTTP response creation, encryption, decryption, serialization, and cryptographic parameter management.

methods.name: CreateClientObliviousResponse
methods.description: Parses and decrypts an Oblivious HTTP response using a given context.

methods.name: CreateServerObliviousResponse
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext payload to create an Oblivious HTTP response using a given context and optional random generator.

methods.name: EncapsulateAndSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the Oblivious HTTP response for transmission.

methods.name: GetPlaintextData
methods.description: Returns the plaintext data of the response.

methods.name: GetCommonAeadParams
methods.description: Determines AEAD parameters based on the HTTP request context.

methods.name: CommonOperationsToEncapDecap
methods.description: Performs common cryptographic operations for response handling.
